```{r}
#| label: fig-flowchart-mermaide
#| fig-cap: "(Mermaide) Study flowchart showing participant exclusion and availability of successfully sequenced samples across time points and genes."
#| out-width: "100%"
#| echo: false
library(DiagrammeR)

mermaid("
graph TB;
  A[Participants randomized] --> X[Excluded from analysis<br/>n = 2<br/>Methylation values across time points conflated<br/>Time points could not be differentiated];
  X --> B[Blood samples collected<br/>at T0, T1, T2<br/>Total samples: 1,078];
  B --> C[Sequencing and quality control<br/>Loss to follow-up occurred];
  C --> D1[BDNF analysis<br/>T0: 140<br/>T1: 122<br/>T2: 97<br/>Total: 359];
  C --> D2[TAU analysis<br/>T0: 142<br/>T1: 123<br/>T2: 97<br/>Total: 362];
  C --> D3[PSD95 analysis<br/>T0: 139<br/>T1: 122<br/>T2: 96<br/>Total: 357];
")

```
```{dot fig-flowchart}
//| label: fig-flowchart
//| fig-cap: "Study flowchart showing participant exclusion and availability of successfully sequenced samples across time points and genes."
//| fig-width: 7
//| fig-height: 9
//| out-width: "100%"

digraph flow {
  rankdir=TB;
  node [shape=box];

  A [label="Participants randomized"];
  X [label="Excluded from analysis\nn = 2\nMethylation values across time points conflated\nTime points could not be differentiated"];
  B [label="Blood samples collected\nat T0, T1, T2\nTotal samples: 1,078"];
  C [label="Sequencing and quality control\nLoss to follow-up occurred"];

  D1 [label="BDNF analysis\nT0: 140\nT1: 122\nT2: 97\nTotal: 359"];
  D2 [label="TAU analysis\nT0: 142\nT1: 123\nT2: 97\nTotal: 362"];
  D3 [label="PSD95 analysis\nT0: 139\nT1: 122\nT2: 96\nTotal: 357"];

  A -> X -> B -> C;
  C -> D1;
  C -> D2;
  C -> D3;
}
```
